description: This Java class defines a CoAP resource for handling OTA package requests, including authentication, fetching OTA package data, and responding to client requests within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: OtaPackageTransportResource
classes.description: A CoAP resource handling OTA package requests, including authentication and data retrieval.

methods.name: processHandleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests, initiates processing of access token.

methods.name: processHandlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests, responds with method not allowed.

methods.name: processAccessTokenRequest
methods.description: Processes access token from request, performs device authentication.

methods.name: getOtaPackageCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon successful device credential validation to fetch OTA package.

methods.name: decodeCredentials
methods.description: Decodes device token credentials from request URI path.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Returns the resource itself for any child request.

methods.name: OtaPackageCallback
methods.description: Inner class handling OTA package response processing.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during OTA package retrieval.

methods.name: respondOtaPackage
methods.description: Prepares and sends OTA package data in response.
